context: Professional online PDF utility platform (merge, compress, split, convert, rotate, organize, etc.)
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / PERFORMANCE PRO hybrid (Clean white background, modern indigo/violet #6366F1 / #4F46E5 accents, slate-900 typography)

key_features: Drag-and-drop multi-file upload with instant file cards
Simulated client-side/server-side PDF processing pipeline with real-time progress bars
Interactive options for each tool (compression level, page range selector, rotate degree, reorder)
Download result button with instant mock generated file download
Admin dashboard with stats cards, recent conversion logs, and tool enable/disable toggles
Full responsive navigation, SEO metadata, breadcrumbs, FAQ accordions, blog articles, and legal pages

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA minimum for all text and UI elements
